Industrial research at Utopi

Descriptions are intentionally high level. Client data, commercial thresholds, proprietary calibration choices and implementation details are omitted.

Project areaContribution
Energy benchmarking & technical efficiencyWeather-normalised benchmarking using change-point modelling, stochastic frontier analysis, efficiency estimation, quality controls and portfolio reporting.
Mould-risk analyticsHourly mould-risk modelling based on published Ojanen/VTT methodology using indoor environmental telemetry.
Legionella proxy riskRisk prioritisation combining occupancy/stagnation evidence with thermal behaviour to support targeted operational checks.
Heat-loss estimationInverse cooling-event models estimating relative heat-loss behaviour from passive temperature decay.
Anomalous heating / rogue heatersStatistical detection of indoor-temperature behaviour inconsistent with expected outdoor conditions, prior state and occupancy evidence.
Unoccupied-heating analyticsPortfolio analysis identifying persistent heating where occupancy evidence is low.
Utopi Index / BEPSMulti-signal building-performance scoring framework productionised as a deployable analytical service with validation and model-QA workflows.
